title: Create chatbot/api/memory.py router and register in chatbot/api/app.py
description:
Create chatbot/api/memory.py — the FastAPI router exposing the memory management API endpoints — and register it in chatbot/api/app.py.

Endpoints to implement:
- GET /api/memories — list/view memories (pagination, optional privacy filter)
- PATCH /api/memories/{memory_id}/pin — pin/unpin
- DELETE /api/memories/{memory_id} — delete (soft or hard)
- PATCH /api/memories/{memory_id} — edit content/metadata
- PATCH /api/memories/{memory_id}/privacy — set privacy level (private/temporary/permanent)
- POST /api/memories/{memory_id}/do-not-remember — flag for exclusion
- POST /api/memories/{memory_id}/remember-forever — mark permanent
- PATCH /api/memories/{memory_id}/correct — correct a misunderstanding
- GET /api/memories/search — search with date/topic/pagination
- GET /api/memories/export — export filtered memories as JSON or text
- GET /api/memories/{memory_id}/provenance — explain a memory's provenance

Wire these to the domain modules from tasks b.1-b.4. Use Pydantic schemas for request/response. Require authentication (reuse the existing auth dependency from the chatbot API). After creating the router, register it in chatbot/api/app.py by adding the router include line.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/api/app.py for router registration pattern and auth dependency
- chatbot/memory/provenance.py, controls.py, search.py, export.py for function signatures
- chatbot/db/models.py for memory model fields

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

SINGLE-OWNER FILE: chatbot/api/app.py is owned exclusively by this task in this phase. No other task may modify it.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/memory.py exists with a FastAPI APIRouter
All listed endpoints are implemented and import cleanly
Endpoints delegate to chatbot/memory/controls.py, search.py, export.py, and provenance.py
Auth dependency is applied to all memory endpoints
chatbot/api/app.py includes the memory router via app.include_router()
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside chatbot/api/memory.py and chatbot/api/app.py
change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends
